title: Security Engineer Intern
description: Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? Coinbase is building the future of finance for people, institutions and their agents, with one place to trade crypto, equities, derivatives and prediction markets, use stablecoins, and connect AI agents with clear controls. The bar is high and the pace is intense, and we like it that way. This isn’t a place for complacency. It’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits and do the best work of your career. If you’re ready to build the future of finance with a championship team who refuse to settle for “good enough,” you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for in-person working sessions This is a 12-week internship during summer 2027.  Coinbase’s Application Security team is rethinking how offensive security works. We use frontier AI models to find vulnerabilities at scale, red team our own AI systems, and automate the parts of security work that don't need a human. As an intern, you'll join that effort on a scoped project and see your work used in real security decisions. What you'll do: Build and test tooling that uses frontier AI models to surface vulnerabilities across Coinbase’s products, working alongside senior engineers on design and review. Help red team internal AI systems - probing for prompt injection, jailbreak attempts, and tool misuse, then documenting what you find and how to fix it. Automate pieces of the vulnerability triage, validation and remediation workflows so the bug bounty, vulnerability response pipelines move faster and become AI native. Reproduce and verify reported vulnerabilities across common classes (OWASP Top 10, SANS Top 25), and write findings that engineering partners can act on. Practice responsible AI use: keep a human in the loop, measure whether your tooling actually improves speed or quality, and be honest when it doesn’t. Required Skills and Experience: Currently pursuing a degree or certificate in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Mathematics or a related area discipline. Proficiency in Python or Go and strong software development skills shown through coursework, personal projects and internships. Curiosity about LLMs and a willingness to experiment: you’ve at least tried building with a model API and thought about how it could be manipulated. Experience with security tooling such as Burp Suite, Semgrep, fuzzing frameworks, or Metasploit. Hands-on exploration of prompt injection or jailbreak techniques. Clear communication, especially in writing - you can explain a technical finding to someone who has to fix it. Experience with GitHub and AWS. title: Software Engineer II
description: Why Sony Interactive Entertainment? Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we’re part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity. Software Engineer II San Mateo, CA   Role Overview Sony Interactive Entertainment LLC seeks a Software Engineer II in San Mateo, CA to own build integration, dependency management, type registration, and repository level platform infrastructure.   Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science or related field or equivalent and two (2) years of experience developing application features, platform integrations, and device interfacing using C++; performing performance analysis and optimization using profiling, monitoring, and diagnostic tools including performance profilers, local logging systems, and runtime monitors; developing automated testing frameworks, regression suites, and unit tests using Jest/NUnit to improve software quality and reliability; debugging and resolving system level issues through root cause analysis and systematic troubleshooting; developing software that interfaces with runtime environments, software development kits (SDKs), and device hardware; developing APIs and data processing systems for software integration, data exchange, and application services using relational databases, cloud services, and platform Web APIs; developing, modifying, and optimizing software architecture components using object-oriented programming (OOP) principles and architectural design patterns including MVP and MVC; developing user interface components for desktop, console, and platform applications. Telecommuting and/or working from home may be permissible pursuant to company policies.   Please refer to our  Candidate Privacy Notice  for more information about how we process your personal information, and your data protection rights. This role also may be eligible for a bonus package.
